propositions: Agents file bugs outside an epic's hierarchy during execution that are actually deliverable defects but lack caused_by links, causing the direct-children close gate to miss them; a deterministic DET floor using caused_by edges blocks closes when open/in_progress bugs directly link to the epic or descendants.

A timing-anchored candidate filter identifies potentially relevant open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first in_progress transition or linked to the epic subtree (any relation, any depth), capped at 32 candidates with overflow tallied.

A single-turn haiku relevance screen forces per-candidate classification (A: defect in epic's change/built; B: same subsystem pre-existing; C: unrelated) with citation, riding model-class config and shared cache settings (warm then parallel fan-out).

The completion verifier receives at most 8 compact A-verdict candidates (title+citation+id) forwarded inside the precheck-assembled fenced context and adjudicates via store-grounded show_ticket checks, blocking only undispositioned deliverable-defects satisfying a disposition rule (supersedes/duplicates link OR reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose).
Screen verdicts are normalized through an overlap_verdict-idiom output schema (epic_bug_screen_verdict) with a validator that defaults garbled/missing verdicts to C (unrelated, safe non-surfacing).
Screen tally (per-bug verdict, citation, overflow count) is recorded in the completion sidecar; screen failure degrades open with logged reason, never blocks; DET floor is the hard blocking tier.
